newsitem.title: USA: View Tech to merge with USTeleCenters.
newsitem.headline: View Tech to merge with USTeleCenters.

text.p: View Tech Inc said it agreed to merge with USTeleCenters Inc, a major authorized sales agent for regional bell operating companies and long distance carriers.
It said the merger, which is expected to be acounted for as a pooling of interests, expands the market areas it serves and broadens its offering of network products and services.

Shareholders of USTeleCenters will receive about 2.5 million shares of View Tech common stock, valued in excess of $17 million. The agreement is subject to the approval of due diligence by both companies.
